한국외식창업교육원: Korea Food Service Startup Education Center
Welcome. I am Ahn Hyeong-sang, Chairman of the Korea Food Service Startup Education Center.
먼저 저희 한국외식창업교육원 홈페이지를 방문해 주신 여러분께 깊은 감사의: Thank you for visiting the Korea Food Service Startup Education Center website.
외식산업은 단순히 먹거리를 제공하는 것을 넘어, 사람들의 삶에 풍요와 행: Food service does more than provide meals. It enriches lives, brings happiness, and creates culture and value. In a rapidly changing world, our industry calls for creativity, innovation and sincerity, opening up new possibilities and challenges.
사단법인 한국외식창업교육원은 \"미래를 선도하는 외식산업의 동반자\"라는: Guided by our mission to be a partner shaping the future of food service, we are committed to providing practical, forward-looking education for aspiring entrepreneurs and industry professionals.
우리는 여러분의 꿈과 비전을 실현할 수 있도록 든든한 동반자로 함께하며,: We work alongside you to turn your dreams and vision into reality and to build a sustainable food service ecosystem.
Our work is guided by three core goals.
급변하는 외식산업 트렌드와 기술을 반영한 실용적인 교육을 통해 시대가 요: We develop skilled professionals through practical education that reflects changing food service trends and technologies.
창업의 첫걸음부터 안정적인 정착에 이르기까지 컨설팅, 멘토링, 마케팅 지: From the first steps of starting a business to establishing stable operations, we offer comprehensive consulting, mentoring and marketing support.
창업자, 소상공인, 그리고 관련 기관 간의 긴밀한 협력 체계를 구축하여: We connect entrepreneurs, small businesses and related institutions to strengthen the industry and contribute to local communities.
외식업은 지속적인 도전과 열정을 필요로 하는 영역입니다. 하지만 올바른: Food service demands continued effort and passion. With a partner who offers direction and works through challenges alongside you, each challenge can become the start of success.
한국외식창업교육원은 여러분의 열정이 결실을 맺을 수 있도록 늘 곁에서 최: We promise to stand by you with education and support that help your passion bear fruit.
여러분의 원대한 꿈과 도전이 이곳 한국외식창업교육원에서 시작되기를 진심으: We sincerely hope your ambitions and new ventures begin here at the Korea Food Service Startup Education Center.
성공적인 외식 창업을 위해 최고의 실무진과 차별화된 프로세스를 제공합니다: Experienced professionals and a distinctive approach to help your food service business succeed.
특급호텔 40년 현장 경력과 국가 심사위원, 학술 연구를 갖춘 외식 명장: A culinary master's journey through 40 years in luxury hotels, national judging and academic research.
